text:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — we need to run through the pubstore listing checklist for the 3-cloud launch. Focus: AWS/GCP/Azure initial setup, branding assets, EULA/trial terms. Who can pick up packaging + AMI/SKU handoff?
aj-product: I can take the packaging mapping (SKUs + trial flags). Need visibility into the trial entitlement window and whether we expose a 14d trial or 30d.
katy-legal: Preference is 14d for now (reduces billing support churn). I need the proposed EULA snippet for trial-terms and any 3rd-party notices. Can someone drop a draft?
tom-ops: For AWS/GCP we'll need publisher IAM roles + a staging AMI/manifest. I still need the account IDs and CI role ARN to provision access. Also: region list (us-west-2, us-east-1, europe-west1, asia-southeast1) — confirm.
sanjay-eng: FYI, the dedicated packaging requires a small bootstrap script and an autoscaling policy attached. I'll paste the minimal manifest we'll use:```json
{
  "name": "redwood-inference-pub-ami",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "bootstrap": "s3://redwood-pub/bootstrap.tar.gz",
  "iam_role": "REPLACE_WITH_ROLE_ARN"
}
```Use that as a template — we'll replace the ARN when ops provisions.
maria-partnerships: Katy — can you confirm whether the EULA needs an explicit data residency clause? Customer asked about EU-only deployment for a pilot.
katy-legal: Add a clause: "Customer data stored in EU regions will remain within EU unless Customer authorizes otherwise." Short and standard. Also add contact for DSARs. I'll push a short paragraph by EOD.
aj-product: Branding/marketing assets: we have a hero logo + 3 screenshots. Need standardized sizes for AWS/GCP/Azure tile: hero 1024x512, thumbnail 300x120, and a 1-page listing doc. Uploading to the drive now: https://drive.redwood.ai/partnerships/pubstore-assets (internal)
tom-ops: Maria — send me the publisher account IDs in DM. Once I have them I'll spin staging images and share AMI IDs in this thread.
maria-partnerships: ack. I'll DM. Also, quick question: do we want separate SKUs per cloud or a unified SKU with mapping?
aj-product: Prefer unified SKU with platform mapping in the catalog — simpler for billing. But need to ensure trial flag maps per-cloud in the publisher metadata.
katy-legal: One more legal ask: include a short "third-party libraries" disclosure for OSS licenses in the listing. Send me the dependency list or point me to the repo.
sanjay-eng: Repo is at gitlab.redwood/infra/pub-ami, deps file under /third_party/licenses.txt. I'll open a PR to add a generated summary for legal.
maria-partnerships: Thanks. On announcements: Partnerships + Marketing want to coordinate a joint announcement next week if the listing goes green. Can Marketing get a final asset pack by Thursday?
aj-product: Yes — I'll produce a one-pager and a short feature blurb.
tom-ops: Deploy-bot created staging cluster for publisher test: deploy-bot: Staging cluster for pubstore is up in us-west-2 — run smoke tests.
deploy-bot: [automated] smoke-tests: 12/12 passed.
katy-legal: Draft EULA posted: https://drive.redwood.ai/legal/pubstore-eula-v1.docx — please review and comment.
maria-partnerships: Great progress. Next actions: aj -> packaging mapping & one-pager (due Thu); tom -> AMI IDs + role ARNs (due Wed); katy -> EULA + OSS disclosure paragraph (due EOD); sanjay -> PR for license summary (when ready). Ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
